summary: HA Sustainable Infrastructure Capital, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a new $2.250 billion, 5-year unsecured revolving credit facility under a CarbonCount-based agreement, replacing its prior $1.825 billion facility. The new credit agreement matures July 2031, with drawn interest at 157.5 bps plus Term SOFR (5 bps sustainability adjustment) and a commitment fee of 27 bps on undrawn amounts. JPMorgan acted as administrative agent and lead arranger with 18 relationship lenders. This is a routine refinancing of a credit facility, not a special situation; no deal terms are applicable.
